تحتوشوا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَوِشُوا (taḥtawišū) /taħ.ta.wi.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# تُحْتَوَشُوا (tuḥtawašū) /tuħ.ta.wa.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
